Customer messaging: contacts, companies, conversations, tickets and help center articles.

## API key

- **Get your key here:** [app.intercom.com](https://app.intercom.com/a/apps/_/developer-hub)
- **Setting:** `INTERCOM_API_TOKEN`
- **API reference:** [developers.intercom.com](https://developers.intercom.com/docs/build-an-integration/learn-more/rest-apis)

### Get the key

1. Sign in to Intercom and open [app.intercom.com](https://app.intercom.com/a/apps/_/developer-hub).
2. Create an API key (or token) with only the access your apps need.
3. Copy it. Many providers show a key only once.

**What to create:** The Access Token of a private app in your workspace's Developer Hub, sent as a bearer token. Searching contacts, conversations or tickets is a POST, so an app that searches asks for write.

Steps for this provider are brief. [Open an issue](https://github.com/every-app/every-app/issues/new?template=provider-request.yml&title=Provider%20guide%3A%20Intercom) to request a full guide.

### Set it on your Gateway

From your EveryApp folder:

```bash
pnpm everyapp secret set INTERCOM_API_TOKEN
```

It asks for the value at a hidden prompt, and it's live at once, with no deploy. If an app you've installed needs it, `pnpm everyapp configure <app>` asks for it along with everything else the app needs.

### Use it in an app

List it in the app's `everyapp.config.ts`:

```ts
capabilities: {
  intercom: { access: "read", why: "What the app does with it." },
},
```

`access` is `"read"` (or `"write"` where it changes things). The app calls the provider's own URLs with `integrationFetch()`, and the Gateway adds the key. More in [API providers](/docs/agent/providers).

### Check it worked

- `pnpm everyapp provider show intercom` shows the key as set and which apps use it.
- `pnpm everyapp status` shows apps that were waiting for it as ready.
- To test the key itself, `GET https://api.intercom.io/me` with it should answer 200; the call is free.

### Cost and limits

- **Rate limits:** 10000 a minute. Per workspace, shared by its private apps; 25,000 a minute across all apps; counted in 10-second windows.
